connection_attempt_delay_ms.applicability: Dual-stack connection racing where both IPv6 and IPv4 were initiated
connection_attempt_delay_ms.definition: Observed interval between initial IPv6 SYN and subsequent initial IPv4 SYN (RFC 8305 §5)
connection_attempt_delay_ms.limitations: Defined only when IPv6 precedes IPv4; null when primary IPv6 wins without race.

dns_last_positive_response_to_first_payl.applicability: Trials with positive DNS responses and server application payload
dns_last_positive_response_to_first_payl.definition: Elapsed time from latest positive DNS response to first server payload byte
dns_last_positive_response_to_first_payl.display_label: Last DNS Response to First Payload
dns_last_positive_response_to_first_payl.limitations: Measures connection establishment and HTTP turnaround excluding resolution wait.

dns_latency_a_ms.definition: Elapsed duration for IPv4 A query/response transaction

dns_latency_aaaa_ms.definition: Elapsed duration for IPv6 AAAA query/response transaction
dns_latency_aaaa_ms.limitations: Reflects configured S6 DNS impairment delay.

dns_query_to_first_payload_ms.applicability: Trials with paired DNS and server application payload
dns_query_to_first_payload_ms.definition: Elapsed time from earliest DNS query (A or AAAA) to first server payload byte on primary stream
dns_query_to_first_payload_ms.limitations: Covers full application readiness from name resolution start.

dns_resolution_time_ms.definition: Total elapsed time across DNS transactions from earliest query to latest response
dns_resolution_time_ms.limitations: Encompasses both A and AAAA query/response windows.

syn_to_synack_ms.applicability: Primary stream where server returned SYN/ACK
syn_to_synack_ms.definition: Elapsed time from primary initial SYN to matching server SYN/ACK segment
syn_to_synack_ms.limitations: Diagnostic proxy for network path RTT; historical legacy connection setup metric.

t_connect_ms.definition: Elapsed time from initial SYN to matching client final ACK on primary stream (RFC 9293 §3.5)
t_connect_ms.limitations: Measures transport handshake only; does not include application request/response transfer.

t_setup_total_ms.applicability: All trials with completed primary HTTP flow
t_setup_total_ms.definition: Elapsed time from first target-host SYN of any family to matching final ACK of primary stream
t_setup_total_ms.limitations: Headline metric for user-visible fallback latency cost; includes CAD stall.
